steps.en: Diplomat/military notices are temporarily suspended under a set code and period
steps.id: Notice diplomat/militer ditangguhkan sementara dengan kode dan periode tertentu
steps.why_en: They are suspended permanently at the third reminder stage, with no period.
steps.why_id: Notice ditangguhkan permanen di tahap reminder ketiga, tanpa periode.

steps.en: The system finds entities with a set number of outstanding notices across their vehicles
steps.id: OCMS mengenali entity dengan jumlah notice outstanding tertentu di semua kendaraannya
steps.why_en: Only a single-ID search exists; no sweep with a threshold.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pencarian satu ID; tidak ada penyisiran dengan ambang.

steps.en: Notices are selected by preset conditions on suspension status, code and type
steps.id: Notice dipilih dengan kondisi preset: status, kode, dan jenis suspension
steps.why_en: Only a basic not-permanently-suspended check exists.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada cek dasar bukan permanent suspension.

steps.en: The system produces reminder letters for the notices outstanding under that entity
steps.id: OCMS membuat reminder letter untuk notice outstanding milik entity itu
steps.why_en: Letters are made per notice by stage, not per entity, and sending is blocked.
steps.why_id: Letter dibuat per notice menurut tahap, bukan per entity, dan pengiriman diblokir.

steps.en: The reminder letters are produced in PDF format
steps.id: Reminder letter dibuat dalam format PDF
steps.why_en: PDF is only produced for the advisory letter, not for these reminders.
steps.why_id: PDF hanya dibuat untuk advisory letter, bukan untuk reminder ini.

steps.en: The officer downloads or prints the letters for postage
steps.id: Petugas mengunduh atau mencetak letter untuk dikirim lewat pos
steps.why_en: A generic file list exists, but these letters do not, so nothing to print.
steps.why_id: Daftar file umum ada, tetapi letter ini tidak ada sehingga tidak ada yang dicetak.
